Name: Phase 3 functional acceptance
Purpose: Validate approved functional, accessibility, compatibility, reliability, and usability cases.
Scope: 37 approved cases; 39 attempts including two retests
Environment: Windows 11; Brave 151.1.93.134; Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.77; NVDA 2026.1.1 portable

Name: Phase 5 critical UI regression
Purpose: Detect unintended change in stable critical member and administrator workflows.
Scope: Six tests selected by the regression marker

Name: Phase 6 API contracts and authorization
Purpose: Validate REST contracts, negative paths, CRUD, authorization, and controlled server error handling.

Name: Phase 7 database integrity
Purpose: Validate schema, constraints, persistence, ownership, and API-to-SQL consistency.
Baseline: New temporary SQLite database per test

Name: Phase 8 accessibility assessment
Purpose: Combine automated rules with keyboard, Lighthouse, WAVE, and NVDA assessment.
Scope: Ten automated tests plus recorded manual and tool-assisted checks
Baseline: Local corrected baseline and controlled local defect baseline
Release Decision: No open confirmed finding in tested scope

Name: Phase 9 management integrity
Purpose: Validate IDs, links, cycle counts, defect/retest chains, and required management artifacts.
Release Decision: Phase 9 checkpoint ready; continue after approval

Name: Phase 10 local performance baseline
Purpose: Evaluate the bounded local performance target.
Release Decision: No performance blocker in the bounded local scope

Name: Phase 11 simulated UAT
Purpose: Record stakeholder-oriented acceptance results without implying client delivery.
Scope: Six business-facing scenarios covering member work, continuity, administrator oversight, and sign-out
Execution Mode: Facilitated single-person simulation with Brave replay
Release Decision: Accepted for simulated scope with one deferred enhancement
Evidence: uat/UAT_SUMMARY.md; focused verification: 20 passed; complete project regression: 114 passed

Name: Phase 12 remediation and retest assurance
Purpose: Independently confirm closed defect corrections and run impact-based regression.
Scope: Four managed defect confirmations plus six critical regression cases
Release Decision: No remediation or regression blocker in the tested scope
Evidence: remediation/PHASE_12_RETEST_SUMMARY.md; focused verification: 12 passed; complete project regression: 121 passed

Name: Phase 13 local CI-equivalent quality gates
Purpose: Validate workflow commands, reports, blocking thresholds, and artifact handling before hosted execution.
Scope: Unit and artifact; API; database; smoke; critical regression; accessibility
Baseline: Corrected local baseline and workflow candidate
Release Decision: Workflow candidate may proceed to hosted validation after approval
